_comment: MCP configuration for this project (GAIDE convention: a leading underscore in the server name disables it — remove the underscore to enable). Per-tool connection notes in docs/mcp-setup.md. Never commit credentials here: use ${ENV_VAR} references.

playwright._doc: Browser automation for empirical verification (see the verifier skill): the agent exercises the running app end-to-end and takes screenshots before moving an acceptance criterion to 'verified'. Point it at the dev server from init.sh (http://127.0.0.1:3100).

_postgres-readonly._doc: Read-only inspection of the Prisma database (schema, data shape) while writing specs. Enable by removing the leading underscore and exporting WAVE_READONLY_DATABASE_URL pointing at a read-only role — never the app's DATABASE_URL.

_github._doc: Pull requests and issues on WaveCondominium/wave-condominium. The gh CLI already covers this for most sessions; enable only if you want the agent to read issues directly, with a minimum-scope token.
